name: Scroll Filter Effect
description: Scroll-driven image reveals where each image grows out of an SVG turbulence-distorted mask while two-part titles flip from a centered row into a grid layout beside it.
contents: Seven story sections, each with a two-part title, paragraph and masked image
Per-section SVG filter with turbulence displacement
behavior: Image mask (circle or path) expands with scroll while a displacement filter distorts its edge
Titles move from a centered row into a per-section grid layout using GSAP Flip
Image scales up and brightens as it reveals
Below 53em sections use a simple stacked layout, from 53em each section uses its own grid layout
editableByProps: Number of sections, titles, text, images, layout number and mask settings
Background and text colors, title size and gap, text opacity, spacing between sections
Scroll start and end, image scale and brightness range, smooth scroll on or off

needsCodeEdit.change: Change title font weights or italic styling
needsCodeEdit.where: [data-title-up] and [data-title-down] rules in the css string

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis when smoothScroll is on, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Each section has a 100vh title step and large spacing between sections to give the scroll animation its range
Layout number must be 1 to 7 to match a layout in LAYOUT_CSS
Desktop grid layouts apply from 53em, narrower screens use a simple stacked layout
